purpose: Test the smallest circuit-motivated repair of the failed Task14 absolute program: retain one scalar of recipient base context along the already frozen direction reader, rather than the full 1,152-D native base head.

prior_art_search.result: The context-free ten-head program failed decisively, proving a context term is needed. The existing fixed direction readers prospectively predict displacement effects, but no intervention has used them as the sole retained coordinate of native base-head deviation. No rank, PCA, or template-conditioned repair is licensed.

construction: For key (direction, cardinality), derive mean_base = frozen_absolute_head - frozen_displacement. For each third-corpus cell compute only s = r_direction dot (native_base - mean_base), then install absolute_head + r_direction*s/(r_direction dot r_direction). This exactly preserves the frozen reader coordinate of base deviation and discards all 1,151 orthogonal coordinates.

predictions.pred_a_immutable_reader_aligned_instrume: All artifacts remain immutable; the scalar correction reproduces the native-base reader coordinate within 1e-5; source/downstream closure errors are at most 1e-4; all 512 cells join exactly to the native-effect reference.
predictions.pred_b_one_scalar_context_restores_effec: Across 512 cells, corrected absolute-head effects reproduce native exact effects at cosine at least 0.75, relative L2 at most 0.75, norm ratio 0.25 to 2.0, and sign agreement at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_each_direction_template_and_cardi: Every direction-by-template and cardinality group has cosine at least 0.65 and sign agreement at least 0.65.
predictions.pred_d_context_dependency_reduced_to_one: Replacement construction consumes one scalar of native base-head state per edit plus a frozen reader direction; it does not consume the full base vector after projection. No template, row, rank, or outcome-conditioned parameter is added.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_price: Validation uses five forwards, 1,120 example evaluations, 1,024 installations, zero fits/backwards/updates, and reuses the ten absolute vectors plus two readers.

terminal_rule: program_screen if all gates pass; null if the immutable instrument passes but one-scalar restoration fails; invalid on hash, projection identity, closure, join, or price mismatch.
